Description: Carson City is Nevada's compact state capital and a consolidated city-county with no state income tax, a Costco and two Walmart Supercenters in city limits, and a VA outpatient clinic in Gardnerville 14 crow-fly miles south; the Reno VAMC hospital is approximately 27 miles north. The city sits at 4700 ft in a high-desert basin flanked by the Carson Range offering four seasons abundant sunshine and quick access to Lake Tahoe recreation. Housing costs are materially lower than Reno the political culture is conservative and the economy is anchored by state government and aerospace manufacturers.
